summary: Validated Phase 33 Xendit production-polling implementation safely on preview without triggering checkout/session creation. Backend suites passed (Phase 33 + safe API + Phase 32 regression), frontend smoke passed for Admin Payments and Label Invoices/WAMI across desktop/tablet/mobile.
action_items: No blocking defects found in tested scope. Optional follow-up: reduce existing React hook dependency lint warnings reported during frontend build.
critical_code_review_comments: Xendit checkout payload implementation is aligned with requirement: POST /sessions, PAY, PAYMENT_LINK, IDR, ID, AUTOMATIC, 30-minute expiry, HTTPS return URLs, and no callback URL dependency.
Ownership guard is correctly enforced in payment status endpoint: non-owner label receives 404, while admin_finance/super_admin can access.
Safety verified: mock-pay endpoint disabled (404) and webhook endpoint disabled (410) under current config.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated temporary labels/users/payments/products in automated tests; all cleaned up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MANDATORY SAFETY respected: no POST /api/payments/{id}/checkout call and no Xendit production session creation during this run. ReleaseDetail Xendit copy is conditional to pending-payment state; sampled demo release was non-pending so checkout copy was not visible there, while WAMI/Invoices production copy was visible.
rca of the issue: No functional bug reproduced in tested Phase 33 scope.
